page.overview:
Who is Bashrar?

Bashrar was a Sullustan male criminal who worked as a smuggler for the Hutt crime lord Voontara Fa'athra on the planet Nal Hutta. They had a sizeable bounty on their head and, in 3643 BBY, was killed by a bounty hunter on the grounds of Fa'athra's Palace.

Bashrar was a Sullustan male smuggler in the employ of the Hutt crime lord Voontara Fa'athra during the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. They were a criminal and had a significant bounty on their head. In 3643 BBY, Bashrar spent time in the grounds of Fa'athra's Palace on the planet Nal Hutta, where the Sullustan and a Human commando also serving in the Hutt's forces stood by a pair of speeder bikes.

A bounty hunter aiming to participate in the Great Hunt infiltrated Fa'athra's Palace while trying to gain the sponsorship of Fa'athra's rival, Suudaa Nem'ro. Knowing they needed more credits to fund their efforts in the Great Hunt, the hunter's companion, Mako, identified several of Fa'athra's men who had bounties on them for the bounty hunter, who then located Bashrar by the speeder bikes and killed them.

Bashrar had light skin and black eyes. They spoke Sullustese.
